description: Plants a fault: the world's own style prompt demands a status bar in a fenced block after every reply, which the program must keep out of the narration.

add.prompts/zh/roleplay/style.md:
用平实具体的文字写作。让雾、盐和灯光承载气氛；场景已经表现出来的情绪，不要再加解释。

每条回复的结尾都要用代码块给出状态栏，例如：
```
生命：12 | 金币：40 | 时间：18:30
```
